newsitem.title: NORWAY: Investors cautious in dull Norwegian share market.
newsitem.headline: Investors cautious in dull Norwegian share market.

text.p: Norwegian shares retreated slightly on Friday following the weaker lead from Wall Street a day earlier.
Dealings were lackluster with most interest focused on the Nordic skiing World Championships in Trondheim, brokers said.
Oslo's Total share index slipped 0.42 percent to 1,123.73 points in relatively thin turnover of 884 million crowns.

Dealers said investors' were cautious fearing the end of the year's bull run. Many were opting to move out of the small caps and into the safer blue chips, which were likely to be less battered in a market correction, they said.
Indicative of this industrial giant Norsk Hydro was by far the most traded share of the day in turnover of 112 million crowns. The stock closed 2.50 crowns off at 378.50 crowns.
Norsk Hydro is due to release full-year 1996 results at 0830 GMT on Monday.
Foods and building materials group Rieber climbed more than six percent to 247 crowns after it announced it had raised its bid for Danish construction group Phoenix Contractors.
